Let's construct our matrix:

- The index $2$ in ${J}_{2}(7)$ means that we have a $2\times 2$ matrix.

- The value $7$ in ${J}_{2}(7)$ means that we have $7$'s on the main diagonal.

- Also, we must have $1$'s on the superdiagonal (the diagonal above the main one).

Given that all the other entries must be zero, our Jordan block is

$$
{J}_{2}(1)=[\begin{aligned}7 & 1 \\ 0 & 7\end{aligned}].
$$
